cards.e: We’ll just have to agree to differ.
cards.uz: har kim oʻz fikrida qolishga kelishmoq
cards.ielts: My brother and I never agree about whether video games are harmful, so in the end we simply agree to differ.
I agree up to a point that university education should be free, but students should still contribute something towards it.
While I appreciate the government's point of view on taxation, I believe wealthy citizens should contribute more to public services.
Most scientists are in agreement that human activity is the main cause of global warming.
The two neighbouring countries have been involved in a bitter dispute over water resources for several decades.
After weeks of negotiations, the workers and management finally came to a compromise on pay and working hours.
There is a clear conflict of opinion between parents and teachers about how much homework children should receive.
Considerable controversy exists over whether genetically modified crops are completely safe for human consumption.
Controversy still rages over whether zoos protect endangered species or simply exploit animals for profit.
When people from different cultures work together, differences sometimes arise, but they can usually be resolved through open communication.
Significant differences exist between urban and rural areas in terms of access to healthcare and education.
I disagree fundamentally with the idea that salary is the most important factor when choosing a job.
Customer service staff are trained not to enter into an argument with customers, even when the customers are rude.
I entirely agree with the view that governments should invest more in renewable sources of energy.
There is a fundamental disagreement among economists about whether raising the minimum wage reduces employment.
Many people simply go along with the view of the majority rather than thinking critically about the issue themselves.
At first my parents were reluctant to go along with my idea of studying abroad, but eventually they agreed.
The new environmental law led to a head-on clash between the government and the country's largest oil companies.

cards.e: We had a very heated argument about immigration the other day.
cards.ielts: Our class had a heated argument about whether mobile phones should be banned in schools.
Health experts are in complete agreement that children should be taught about healthy eating from an early age.

I wholeheartedly agree that every child should have access to free, high-quality education, regardless of family income.
